messages.subject: A problem running module 6
messages.body_plain:
Hello Jamie and the other group members
Thank you for accepting me in the group. Wallace was something that we had been waiting for a long time and fortunately, thanks to you is already available. I am very excited to use Wallace, in fact I am already doing it, but I have run into a problem in executing the models in module 6.
When I give it to run the screen darkens me and R reports this error:

Warning: Error in seq.default: invalid '(to - from) / by'
Stack trace (innermost first):
     81: seq.default
     80: seq
     79: <reactive> [modules / mod_c6_maxent.R # 54]
     68: mod.maxent
     67: noteEventHandler [C: \ Program Files \ R \ R-3.4.4 \ library \ wallace \ shiny / server.R # 501]
      2: shiny :: runApp
      1: run_wallace

Maybe it's something very simple, but I'm really not very good with R, I'm sorry about that!! Please, if someone can help me solve this, I would really appreciate it ...
Thank you.
By the way very good today's conference in the course of Dr Town Peterson

messages.subject: Re: A problem running module 6
messages.body_plain:
Hello Jamie
Take note of what you told me about the RM ranges when you start with 0 and use the Hinge function. However I did several tests with different functions and varying the RM and the steps, to see what happened and if there were some problems in other functions and in RM ranges that did not start at 0. I send you a list of all the tests. I hope it helps to see the problems. Sometimes R suddenly closed and showed a sign of fatal error and had to start a new session.

All tests used Gibif points, Spahtial Thin with a thinning distance= 10km, Worldclim with 30arcsec, for backgroun extent i used Minimun convex plygon, No. backgorund points= 10000, Spatial partition and Block (k=4), Agregation factor=2
I tried all the features classes with ranges of 0-4 and 1-4 and varying the steps from 0.5 to 1 to detect each time I gave a problem. This is the result:
